Run method for signal detection using aggregated data

run_method_parameters.Rd

Wrapper for running different signal detection algorithms using already aggregated data. Used in combination with [get_method_func_parameters()].

Usage

run_method_parameters(
  method_list,
  data_aggregated,
  time_unit,
  n_time_units,
  ...
)

Arguments

method_list

List with method specification generated with [get_method_func_parameters()]

data_aggregated

data.frame with timeseries of cases of one single stratification.

time_unit

Character indicating the time unit aggregation (weekly, biweekly, or monthly)

n_time_units

Integer. Time units of the Signal detection test period.

...

additional arguments for each specific method

Value

data.frame with signal detection results

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
dat <- input_example %>% preprocess_data()
dat_agg <- aggregate_data(dat)

run_method_parameters(get_method_func_parameters("farrington"),
  data_aggregated = dat_agg,
  time_unit = "weekly",
  n_time_units = 6,
  alpha_upper = 0.05
)
} # }
